title: A hello, then a clarification
description: The archive opens with a simple “Hello” and “Hie” — followed almost immediately by Aryan explaining the name situation. A very un-grand beginning, which is kind of perfect.

title: The first Khushi Ji energy
description: Even in the early pages, the polite “Khushi ji” sign-off gets a playful “Nhi na🫠” in reply.

title: The night-owl schedule
description: One of those conversations where the clock quietly gives up: it is already morning, and the good-night / good-morning debate is still going.

title: Tamatar enters the sentence
description: Aryan's own chat calls her “apni tamatar” during a split-screen conversation. The nickname is no longer just a label; it has become part of the everyday language.

title: Pillow-fight negotiations
description: A small playful reunion in the chat, marked by “Itni dino baad tamatar” and an immediate pillow-fight proposal.

title: The broccoli plot twist
description: A two-word comeback creates a tiny piece of shared vocabulary: “Yes broccoli.” The Tamatar / broccoli exchange deserves its own museum shelf.

title: Birthday: four cakes, one archive
description: The November pages preserve small, specific details and the kind of everyday confidence and chaos that make this archive feel like yours.

title: The latest page in the archive
description: The export closes with more quick-fire banter. The universe is still very much under construction.
